errorCodes.meaning: No election with this identifier exists for this community, or the caller may not see it (CONVENTIONS §7).
The election can no longer be cancelled: voting has closed, it is tallied, or it is already cancelled (CONVENTIONS §7).
The ballot box did not answer. The community has stopped issuing the election's tickets and keeps them stopped; the same request may be sent again to finish the cancellation.
The ballot box refused to cancel the election. Its own code and message are carried in `details`. The community keeps the election's tickets stopped.

schema.description: An administrator cancels an election before voting closes: the community stops issuing its tickets and has the ballot box cancel it. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

reason.description: Why the election is cancelled, for the community's audit trail and its members. Required: a cancellation discards every ballot cast, and the members who cast them are owed a reason.

schema.title: VTC Elections — Cancel — payload
